resources.string: When a channel stops working, play another copy of it from your list, such as Lakeshore FHD for Lakeshore HD
Not working. Trying a backup copy (%1$d of %2$d)…
This channel and its backup copies aren\'t working right now
When a channel won\'t load while your internet and the service are working (another channel plays fine), hide it right away. It comes back when a scan finds it working, or with Show again below.
